portfolio_twr_cumulative.$comment: PANEL-VIS-002: headline portfolio return is the governed HWM index series (base 100); the summed-epoch TWR and the difference are published beside it.

portfolio_mwr_annualised.$comment: PANEL-VIS-002: one XIRR over governed external flows; value is null (with the window-equivalent cumulative) when the window is under 365 days.

capital_reconciliation_epoch_set.$comment: R2.1: the report's governed epochs against every epoch-manifest row, epoch by epoch; the outside rows carry the gain that no report total counts.

capital_reconciliation.$comment: PANEL-VIS-002: derived total net capital minus governed invested capital, split into named components that sum to the difference with a zero residual.
